inputs.label: Prey (2006)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of the original Prey (2006). QGPUI copies the .pk4 files from its base folder.

notes: The guide names the PC folder prey/base; the store install folder name and Steam app ID are not given, so the user may have to pick the folder. Older releases are pre-releases with -openxr asset names; the latest is a normal release.
